messages: tara: Quick follow-up from today's design review: our help panel uses "variant" in the title bar but the console shows "model version" on the model selector. Demo confusion. Can we pick a primary term and surface the other as a parenthetical? alex: Yep. My vote is "model version" as primary (users think in versions/releases). Use "variant" parenthetically when referring to runtime configs like quantization: e.g., "v2 (int8 variant)". mike: Accessibility + UX: if we show parenthetical text include a tooltip with a short sentence. For screen readers ensure the tooltip text is reachable. Example aria pattern: ```html Variant = runtime config (quantization, precision) ``` june: Microcopy pro tip: change CTAs that open the in-panel sidecar to "Open docs" and keep external links as "Learn more". That reduces cognitive load. Also add a small caption under the sidecar header: "In-app docs: close to return to console" so users understand behavior. tara: Good. UX note: currently when sidecar closes focus sometimes lands on an unrelated button. We should capture last active element and restore focus. Also ensure ESC closes the sidecar. alex: We should add a short inline line in the help content: "Terminology: model version = release; variant = runtime option (eg int8)." Put it under a "Why this matters" disclosure so it doesn't clutter. mike: For the disclosure use an accessible toggle: role="button" aria-expanded and focusable. Degrade to visible text if JS is off. june: Also: search aliases. People search console for "reserved", "reserved capacity" and land on the Dedicated page in docs but not from the help panel. Let's add alias entries to the help index so the sidecar search returns the same page regardless of wording. tara: Can we add a top-of-panel crosslink to Routing > Model fallback? Support keeps seeing misconfigurations where users tweak model version thinking it's fallback routing. A one-click related doc link would help. alex: Agree. Crosslink should open in sidecar, not new tab. But ensure keyboard trap is fixed first. mike: I'll draft the aria and focus snippet and PR it. Example restore snippet: ```js const last = document.activeElement; openSidecar(); // on close closeSidecar(); if (last) last.focus(); ``` june: I'll update CTA copy in the component library and add alias json for search. Tara, can you add the tiny in-panel caption copy and the "Why this matters" content? tara: On it. Action items: 1) mike -> PR for focus restore + tooltip a11y; 2) june -> CTA copy + help index aliases; 3) alex -> finalize microcopy for parenthetical variant usage; 4) tara -> figma mock for crosslink placement + disclosure text. doc-ops-bot: Docs references: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/terminology and https://docs.redwood.ai/console/routing/fallbacks please link in sidecar. tara: Thanks everyone. We'll validate in the next UX crit; small change but should remove a lot of friction. :white_check_mark:
